svg.title: The Periodic Table of Mastery
svg.desc: A periodic table of 74 credentials across 7 ecosystems, ordered from fundamentals (lightest) to expert (heaviest). Microsoft 46, AWS 3, Google Cloud 14, Anthropic 1, Databricks 2, Snowflake 7, MongoDB 1. 11 fundamentals, 39 associate, 5 specialty, 14 professional, 5 expert. Element 1 is Azure Fundamentals; element 74 is Azure Solutions Architect Expert.
svg.text: 74 credentials · 7 ecosystems · lightest = fundamentals, heaviest = expert
Every tile opens a live, issuer-hosted verification in the vault →
